column1: # Curated S. cerevisiae proteins and complexes of well-established native mass for the SEC apparent-MW calibration,
# curated 2026-11-16 the same way as the human v7 set (anchors_native_mass_human.tsv): abundant, soluble, stable
# assemblies spanning monomers (~15 kDa) to large machines (~1 MDa); the yeast orthologues of most human anchors.
# native_kda = oligomer_n x UniProt monomer mass of the dataset's annotation when oligomer_n is given (homomers), else the
# value in native_kda (heteromeric machines, literature value). Oligomeric states: PDB biological assemblies / textbook
# enzymology. Excluded on purpose as for human: ribosomal proteins, RNP proteins, tubulin/actin, chromatin proteins,
# Hsp104/Tsa1 (state depends on conditions), FAS (2.6 MDa, beyond most SEC columns).
# STATUS: curated by the agent from established knowledge; Pedro / G. Magnusson to review before the first yeast
# build (checklist in docs/reference/history/secms_toolkit_report.md). Not yet tested on yeast SEC-MS data.
